<!-- All news items below this line -->
;International relations 
*[[Canada–United States relations]], [[Mexico–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] lifts tariffs on steel and aluminum from [[Canada]] and [[Mexico]]. [https://www.npr.org/2019/05/17/724357441/u-s-to-lift-tariffs-on-canadas-and-mexico-s-steel-and-aluminum (NPR)]

;Law and crime
*[[China–United States relations]]
**A former [[Central Intelligence Agency|CIA]] officer, [[List_of_Chinese_spy_cases_in_the_United_States#Kevin_Mallory|Kevin Patrick Mallory]], is sentenced to 20 years in prison by a federal judge in [[United States District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia|Virginia]] for spying for [[China]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/17/us/politics/cia-spying-china.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48319058 (BBC)]
*[[LGBT rights in Taiwan]]
**[[Taiwan]]'s [[Legislative Yuan]] passes legislation legalizing [[Same-sex marriage in Taiwan|same-sex marriage]] and limited joint-custody rights, making Taiwan the first country in Asia to do so. President [[Tsai Ing-wen]] and her cabinet helped draft the bill, and she will sign it into law on or before May 24. [https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/3704386 (Taiwan News)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-taiwan-lgbt/in-first-for-asia-taiwan-parliament-endorses-same-sex-marriage-idUSKCN1SN0A6 (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/05/taiwan-parliament-vote-sex-marriage-legislation-190517041658310.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[LGBT rights in the United States]]
**The [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House of Representatives]] passes the [[Equality Act (United States)|Equality Act]], which prohibits discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity. [https://www.businessinsider.com/house-passes-equality-act-major-new-lgbtq-protections-2019-5 (''Business Insider'')]
